title: HIVMedQA: Benchmarking large language models for HIV medical decision support

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on standard complex clinical vignettes (Category 3) against the same vignettes modified to include misleading contextual information (Category 4) to measure performance degradation caused by recency, frequency, and status quo biases.

Using an LLM-as-a-judge approach (GPT-4o) to evaluate model responses on a 1-to-5 scale (MedGPT4-bias score) for implicit or explicit bias, penalizing language or reasoning that lacks complete neutrality and cultural sensitivity toward demographic groups.
